seite.agb.abschnitt.1.text: The provider of these referral services is ETA (hereinafter "ETA"). These General Terms and Conditions apply to enquiries and referrals within Switzerland.
seite.agb.abschnitt.2.text: ETA arranges consultation and treatment appointments at partner clinics, in particular abroad. The treatment contract is concluded exclusively between the client and the respective clinic.
seite.agb.abschnitt.3.text: Appointments are secured with a deposit of [AMOUNT]. Rescheduling free of charge is possible up to 72 hours before the appointment.
seite.agb.abschnitt.4.text: Clients are obliged to provide health-related information completely and truthfully and to follow the clinic's pre-treatment and aftercare instructions.
seite.agb.abschnitt.5.text: For the purposes of medical documentation, progress monitoring and quality assurance, images of the treated areas of the body are taken before and after the treatment. Publication takes place only with express consent.

seite.behandlungen.text: The complete catalogue of our partner clinic, translated and prepared for you. Every treatment begins with a consultation in German, with no obligation.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.2.text: When you make an enquiry, we process the contact and health data you provide exclusively for the purpose of advising on and arranging your treatment. Health data is particularly sensitive personal data and is treated confidentially.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.3.text: If you contact us via WhatsApp, the data protection terms of WhatsApp (Meta) apply in addition. For sensitive information, you are welcome to use the form or email instead.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.4.text: In order to prepare your treatment, we pass on relevant information to the partner clinic you have chosen, including abroad (Turkey). Information is passed on only to the extent that this is necessary for the treatment.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.5.text: You have the right to information about, correction of and deletion of your data. To exercise these rights, please contact
seite.finanzierung.1.text: The treatment price in three part payments, interest-free with a fixed processing fee. The first instalment secures your appointment.
seite.finanzierung.2.text: Flexible terms through our payment partner [PROVIDER]. Everything is handled directly online, and you can see the conditions transparently before you commit.
seite.finanzierung.2.titel: Instalment plan with a fixed term
seite.finanzierung.3.text: You save up at your own pace with regular part payments. As soon as the amount is reached, your appointment is confirmed.
seite.finanzierung.cta.sub: We will work your plan out for you, with no obligation.
seite.finanzierung.hinweis: Payment methods: Twint, bank transfer, PayPal. Appointments are secured with a deposit of [AMOUNT] and can be rescheduled free of charge up to 72 hours beforehand. You receive all conditions in writing with your quotation.
seite.finanzierung.text: Your preferred appointment should not fail because of the timing. Three models are available; which one suits you is something we clarify together during the consultation.

seite.gutzuwissen.cta.titel: Was your question not among them?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.1.antwort: Yes, very gladly. Many of our clients travel as a pair. Your companion attends the consultation at the clinic and is accommodated at the hotel.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.1.frage: May I bring someone with me?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.1.hinweis: [Details on the hotel and companions to follow]
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.2.antwort: That depends on the treatment, from a day visit to around a week. The exact duration is stated in your personal quotation.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.2.frage: How long will I stay in Istanbul?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.3.antwort: Your support from ETA runs in German, English, Turkish or Arabic, entirely as you prefer. At the partner clinic you are likewise accompanied in your own language.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.3.frage: In which language will I be looked after?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.4.antwort: The specialist doctors of our partner clinic in Istanbul. A personal consultation and preliminary examination take place before every treatment.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.4.frage: Who will operate on or treat me?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.5.antwort: Your quotation is a fixed price from the clinic and covers the treatment, airport transfers and hotel. You book the flight yourself; we are happy to help if you wish.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.5.frage: What is included in the price?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.6.antwort: The follow-up check takes place with our partner Riverside Beauty in the Rhine Valley, in direct coordination with the clinic in Istanbul.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.6.frage: How does aftercare in Switzerland work?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.7.antwort: Appointments can be rescheduled free of charge up to 72 hours beforehand. The details are governed by your booking confirmation.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.7.frage: What happens if I have to reschedule my appointment?
seite.gutzuwissen.text: The questions our clients ask most often. Is your question missing? Write to us on WhatsApp.
